summary: Aion Labs' Free tier is the default on signup and allows 15 requests per minute with 20,000 tokens per minute and a 20,000-token daily limit.
claim_steps: Create an Aion Labs account; the Free tier is the default on signup.
Create an API key in the dashboard.
Use the OpenAI-compatible API within 15 requests per minute and 20,000 tokens per day.
